routing.reasoning: Help desk ticketing system requires complex workflow with 10+ sequential steps, multiple decision points, role-based routing, and parallel processes (notifications, SLA tracking). Advanced forms needed for ticket submission with validation, file uploads, and dynamic fields. SQL database optimal for relational data (tickets, users, comments, categories). name: StatusManagementWorkflow
description: Workflow for managing status types, transitions, and configurations in the help desk system. Supervisors can create/update statuses, define allowed transitions, and configure display properties.

data.label: Start Status Management
data.description: Supervisor initiates status management process

data.label: Define Status Configuration
data.description: Supervisor enters status details: name, type, color, display properties, and terminal flag

data.label: Validate Status Data
data.description: Check for duplicate status names, valid color codes, and required fields

data.label: Validation Passed?
data.description: Determine if status configuration is valid

data.label: Save Status Configuration
data.description: Persist status type to database with all properties

data.label: Define Status Transitions
data.description: Supervisor configures allowed transitions from this status to other statuses

data.label: Validate Transitions
data.description: Ensure no circular dependencies and terminal statuses have no outgoing transitions

data.label: Transitions Valid?
data.description: Check if transition rules are valid

data.label: Save Transition Rules
data.description: Persist allowed status transitions to database

data.label: Notify System Users
data.description: Send notification to agents and supervisors about new/updated status configuration

data.label: Status Management Complete
data.description: Status configuration successfully saved and activated

data.label: Notify Validation Error
data.description: Inform supervisor of validation errors in status data

data.label: Notify Transition Error
data.description: Inform supervisor of validation errors in transition rules

Advanced forms needed for ticket submission with validation, file uploads, and dynamic fields. SQL database optimal for relational data (tickets, users, comments, categories). Cross-platform mobile support for field agents. Sequential domain with approval-like patterns for ticket resolution workflow.

routing.reasoning: Help desk ticketing system requires complex workflow with 10+ sequential steps, multiple decision points, role-based routing, and parallel processes (notifications, SLA tracking). Advanced forms needed for ticket submission with validation, file uploads, and dynamic fields. SQL database optimal for relational data (tickets, users, comments, categories). Cross-platform mobile support for field agents. Sequential domain with approval-like patterns for ticket resolution workflow.
